subject: resources.records

entries.definition: An external account, platform, shared asset, or registry used by an organization, represented by portable purpose, access-reference, administration, organization, and validation-date facts without credential material.

limitations: This vocabulary defines portable external-resource meaning only; it does not expose credentials, establish access, validate a provider record, or grant read, write, disclosure, or execution authority.
Provider and policy projections must bind this exact artifact and fail visibly on drift; copied definitions never become canonical.
